caption: The drawing depicts a ship's figurehead in the shape of a woman dressed in an elaborate historical costume. The figurehead features a woman with pale skin, wearing a dress with multiple layers and ruffles, predominantly in shades of white with gold trimming and accents. Her hair is styled up and adorned with ribbons, also shown in a pale color with gold highlights. She is wearing a necklace, earrings, and a bracelet, all indicated with gold. The dress has decorative elements including a sash and rosettes on the sleeves and bodice. She is positioned with her head slightly turned to the right, arms folded across her chest, and the upper body angled upwards. The supporting structure beneath her, intended to be mounted on the prow of a vessel, is painted in dark blue and decorated with ornate gold detailing, featuring scrollwork and leaf motifs. The background of the image is plain and off-white, with subtle shading giving depth around the figurehead, and there are no other objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Figurehead: "Belle of Bath"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
